messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: bitness
parts:
CRAN will build both 32-bit and 64-bit binary versions of R packages, so I believe it normally requires both to work. So, I think 32-bit support needs to go into TODO.

That said, I just tried test-all with -m32 and everything passed, so maybe it won't be that much additional work.

Daniel, can Jenkins run without and then with the -m32 flag? You might need to install some cross-compiling libraries on the Jenkins machine.

Ben
